newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - W. Seneca Central SD, N.Y.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - W. Seneca Central SD, N.Y.

text.p: Sealed proposals will be received and considered by the undersigned President of the Board of Education of West Seneca Central School District, Erie County, New York, at the Office of Willkie, Farr &Gallagher, 900 Third Avenue, 17th Floor, New York, New York 10022 until 11:00 o'clock A.M., Prevailing Time,

at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the purchase IN FEDERAL FUNDS at not less than par and accrued interest of $8,750,000 School District (Serial) Bonds, 1997, of said School District, dated May 1, 1997, and maturing $350,000 on May 1, 1998, $400,000 on May 1, 1999, $500,000 on May 1, 2000, $600,000 on May 1 in each of the years 2001 to 2012, both inclusive, and $300,000 on May 1, 2013, with interest thereon payable on May 1, 1998 and semi-annually thereafter on November 1 and May 1.

THE SCHOOL DISTRICT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CHANGE THE TIME AND/OR DATE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS. NOTICE OF ANY SUCH CHANGE SHALL BE PROVIDED NOT LESS THAN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO THE TIME SET FORTH ABOVE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS BY MEANS OF A SUPPE OF SALE TO BE TRANSMITTED OVER THE MUNIFACTS WIRE.

Bonds maturing on or before May 1, 2006 are not subject to redemption prior to maturity. Bonds maturing on or after May 1, 2007 are subject to redemption, at the option of the School District, prior to maturity, in whole or in part, on any interest payment date on or after May 1, 2006, at redemption prices, expressed as a percentage of par as follows: May 1, 2006 to April 30, 2007, 101%; and May 1, 2007 and thereafter, 100%.

Each bid, accompanied by a $175,000 good faith check, must be for all of said $8,750,000 serial bonds. Unless all bids are rejected, the award will be made to the bidder complying with the terms of the complete notice of sale and offering to purchase said bonds at such rate or rates of interest as will produce the lowest net interest cost.
The purchaser will be furnished without cost, the

unqualified legal opinion as to the validity of the Bonds of Willkie Farr &Gallagher, New York, New York, Bond Counsel. For further information regarding the Bonds and to obtain copies of the complete Notice of Bond Sale, Bid Form, and the Preliminary Official Statement of the School District, please contact Evensen Dodge Inc., telephone: (716) 662- 3910, telecopier: (716) 662-6684.
